reviews.text: Great team, thank you all!

Hello.
I called four vets last week one afternoon, and this was the only clinic that could find me an appointment before closing time.
My rabbit hadn't eaten for 24 hours, was lethargic, and was standing in a strange position. The vet gave a thorough examination and diagnosed his problem (dental). The next day, they operated and gave me excellent advice.
After two or three days of recovery, he is completely healed, in great shape, and has resumed his usual diet.
I thank them and recommend this clinic for their kindness, efficiency, and great flexibility.

Thank you for your support during the painful ordeal of losing our rat, Blanche.
The veterinarian who saw us was understanding and very reassuring. Her support was exceptional and helped us immensely.

Highly competent staff...
They take care of my two dachshunds...
Thank you to them, by the way...

I brought my kittens in for spaying/neutering today. It's a partner clinic of the association where I adopted them. The clinic is pleasant, and the veterinarians and assistants are extremely welcoming. The service, from making the appointment to the day of the procedure, was excellent. Everyone is lovely, caring, and generous with advice and information. It's reassuring. It's a shame it's so far from my home; otherwise, I would have gladly continued their veterinary care there.
Very attentive, very good veterinarian

Always so kind and compassionate with our canine and feline friends.
They've been with us through thick and thin for 18 years.
Excellent care.
Great advice and treatment.
What more can I say? Thank you to the entire team.
I highly recommend them.

My princess, a sacred Birman cat, had emergency surgery at this clinic eight days ago. The operation went well, as did the post-operative care. She was treated with great care. Information and follow-up appointments after the operation were prompt. My princess is recovering well and has regained her appetite and her desire to play. I am very grateful to the entire team. I felt reassured and confident, as I was very worried.
Top-notch staff
Top team, my favorite is Jade...

Overall, I had a very positive impression of this veterinary clinic. The spaces are well-designed for animals, both cats and dogs, with a welcoming reception area and a pleasant terrace for sunny days. I also appreciated the veterinarian's responsiveness and approachable manner.

The clinic's openness to emergencies and walk-ins is commendable and humane, but can sometimes lead to delays or unclear opening hours, which can cause waiting times. Better organization or communication could help streamline this.

Access without a car is a little more challenging, although the clinic is still accessible by public transport.
Very good vet
Excellent service. The explanations were very clear and the advice was helpful. Thank you for your warm welcome and professionalism. We came for a booster vaccination.
Dear, very dear

A loyal customer for at least 7 years. A professional like this is becoming increasingly rare! The veterinarians are full of compassion and patience. Very reasonable prices and they accept pet insurance. Even after moving, I'm still a customer. I'll never change!

I wanted to thank the entire team at this clinic who were wonderful. We dealt with Dr. Caruso who clearly explained and presented the different options available to us. Unfortunately, Mimiche (due to a lack of resources, not competence on the part of the team) passed away. They were with us until the very end. A huge thank you again to the whole team.
A team that loves their little charges. A big thank you to Nanou for her support. Thank you for your empathy and professionalism. (Thank you for the heartwarming card I received.)

What can I say about this clinic that refuses to sell me Megecat, the contraceptive pill for female cats?

The excuse: they have to see the animal...
Imagine, Madam, that if selling could get you the animal...it would be for sterilization.

I have 17 cats.
All of them are sterilized.

This one...impossible.
I have all the equipment...cage, trap, and everything.
No way.
So, to avoid the proliferation of poor, unfortunate animals, I give her the pill in her food...because she comes to eat from time to time.

I explained, begged...got angry.
Same answer: they have to see the animal.
I finally hung up...
And I'll finish my story by saying that the month before, the same people sold it to me without any problem...
Incompetent?
Reckless?
Idiots, no doubt.
They won't see me again, of course.
Luckily, they're not alone.
And most of them agree with me and do what they can for these poor stray kittens, mothers with lifelong courage.
Completely useless.
Thank you for your support and availability when we, pet owners, are very worried about our animals. I wholeheartedly recommend this superb team to take care of your pets!
The vet is super nice and takes very good care of the animals.

Thank you to the Martégaux Veterinary Clinic, and especially to Dr. Alice Duval, who has cared for Gary since he was a puppy.

During the most difficult moments, Dr. Duval demonstrated exceptional patience and kindness. Despite Gary's condition, she knew how to put him at ease, take the time for a thorough consultation, and make a diagnosis with gentleness and precision. She did everything she could to ensure Gary experienced this moment as peacefully as possible.

We had considered consulting another veterinarian for a while due to the distance. But this experience reminded us that it's sometimes better to travel a few extra kilometers. Our animals deserve it, and I assure you, they have a good nose for these things… listen to them, especially at the end of their lives.

The weeks that followed were marked by difficult decisions, doubts, and fears… And throughout this journey, we were listened to, understood, and supported. Dr. Duval directed us (while reminding us that confirmation of the diagnosis is not mandatory) to the best possible center, ensuring that Gary would be cared for respectfully and gently.

I also highly recommend the OLLIOLIS Center – Neurology Department.

Finally, we were deeply touched by the condolence card we received, written by your team. This simple yet profoundly human gesture meant a great deal to us.

Thank you for your professionalism, your compassion, and above all, your love for animals.
Top-notch and caring team

I highly recommend this clinic, as the veterinarians are very professional, combining attentive listening, quality care, and honesty.
The reception is always warm, and you can feel a genuine love for animals, which, unfortunately, is sometimes lacking in other veterinarians.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. Thank you to the whole team for all the excellent care given to my little Huna.
Valérie Carret
Excellent veterinary clinic. Warm and efficient service, top-notch veterinarians and staff. 🙏☀️ …
Receives quickly. Responsive. Professional. Good advice.
A warm welcome; you can tell the vets love animals. A very pleasant first visit, both for us and our dog.
Clinic with pleasant, competent, and reassuring vets

I used to get all my cat's care done there until today... when I had to take my cat in for a check-up. The person who saw us decided, without consulting us, to trim his claws... already a bad sign. I never asked for that for my cat. He took the claws and left for another room. I absolutely did not appreciate this. The vet came back and told us, looking us straight in the eye and without any embarrassment, that he might have cut the claw right down to the root and wasn't sure it would grow back. To this day, my cat's claw hasn't grown back. The visit was at the end of last year. I feel that this clinic no longer respects animals or shows empathy; it's become a real business. They lost my trust after this ordeal, and I will never entrust my cat to them again. Personally, I don't know what happened while I was away, and I blame myself for trusting a 20-year-old to take care of my baby at the time. And of course, I won't even mention the bill for that intervention... so I'm very disappointed and I'll never go back there. Oh well, it was only 5 minutes from my house. I'd rather find someone who still cares about animals and who won't mistreat my cat.

My cat Moumoune was cared for for five years until his passing. He was 19 years and six months old.

I want to sincerely thank the entire team, but especially the veterinarian, Dr. Duval, because beyond her work, she knew how to reassure and comfort me. Her words helped me feel a little better each day, as Moumoune's passing is still so hard for me. I miss my baby terribly. I have no words to describe the kindness of this woman and her team. And I want to thank them for their letter; it's a reminder of Moumoune's presence. Thank you for everything. I will never forget you, and neither will Moumoune.
